verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a GPU, since it ships with companion software (AMD Software, the ROCm stack) that could collect usage data. However, no evidence documents any telemetry setting or opt-out. Mentions of a "private" local workstation, an offline runfile installer, and an open-source stack are adjacent privacy-posture claims, not a documented opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
